name: Easy Sheet Pan Shrimp, Asparagus, Tomato & Corn Bake with Biscuits

ingredients.name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 400°F. Place oven racks in the upper, middle, and lower positions.

Wash, dry, and snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; cut spears into 2-inch long pieces. Wash and dry grape tomatoes. Divide both between two large baking sheet pans along with the corn. Drizzle with oil, season with Old Bay, and toss to combine. Spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch asparagus
2 pint grape tomatoes
4 cups frozen corn
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp Old Bay seasoning

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets on the middle and lower racks of the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until veggies are starting to soften, about 15 minutes.

Meanwhile, if using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry. Season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
680 g raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are starting to soften, remove baking sheets from the oven. Add shrimp, stir to combine, and spread back out in an even layer. Return to the middle and lower racks of the oven. Continue to bake until veggies are tender and shrimp are cooked through, 10-15 minutes more. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, open biscuit tube, separate biscuits, and arrange on another baking sheet. Place on the top rack and bake until biscuits are golden and cooked through, 8-10 minutes. Remove from oven.
Divide shrimp and veggie bake between plates or bowls. Serve with biscuits and butter. Enjoy!
